The facts: purchase of forest land, got a logging permit for 10 cubic meters, but then hired someone to cut more than permitted, resulting in over-logging of 40.202338 cubic meters. So illegal logging beyond permit. The charge likely "非法采伐林木" or "滥伐林木". In earlier examples, they used "滥伐林木" for illegal logging without permit. Also "非法占用农用地" for land occupation.
